//: Dev-only type check. The app itself stays no-build: nothing here is compiled,
bundled or shipped — `tsc --noEmit` reads the same .js the browser loads, and
the types live in JSDoc comments the browser ignores.
This config lives under tests/ for the same reason package.json does.
Deliberately NOT strict. noImplicitAny alone raised 178 findings on one file,
none of which were bugs — annotating every parameter in a 3,900-line file is
not what this is for. What it IS for: catching a misspelled contract field
(`characterRespone`, `tracking.arousel`), which is the failure an agent editing
this code is most likely to introduce and the least likely to notice.
`files` is an allowlist that grows as files are typed — see roadmap Phase 3,
'other files get typed only as they're touched'.
